name: Daniel Stanton
role: Early Ohio elder and Missouri leader
dateNote: He was baptized on 3 November 1830; section 75 names him in January 1832.
importance: Section 75 pairs him with Seymour Brunson for a mission. He moved to Jackson County in 1832 and helped lead a branch in Independence. He later served on high councils in Missouri and Illinois and settled in the West.
connections: His companion in section 75 was Seymour Brunson.

reviewNote: JSP: born 28 May 1795, Manlius, New York; baptized by Parley P. Pratt 3 Nov. 1830; high priest 25 Oct. 1831; Jackson County 1832; Adam-ondi-Ahman high council 1838; buried in Panaca, Nevada. Death date (26 Oct. 1872, Panaca) from the Church History Biographical Database.
